definitions.gloss: personal motto; favorite maxim; guiding principle
definitions.explanation: A phrase, proverb, or saying that a person keeps in mind as a guiding principle in life. Literally 'inscription at one's right side.'

examples.japanese: ⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{座右|ざゆう}の{銘|めい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{座右|ざゆう}の{銘|めい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{継続|けいぞく}は{力|ちから}なり→継続は力なり：20457_keizokuhachikaranari⟧」です。

⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{座右|ざゆう}の{銘|めい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かれる→聞く：00483_kiku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{準備|じゅんび}して→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: You may be asked about your personal motto in an interview, so it's good to prepare one.

notes:
Literally means "inscription at one's right side," referring to the ancient Chinese practice of keeping a guiding inscription on the right side of one's desk. {座右|ざゆう} means "at one's side" and ⟦{銘|めい}→銘：24393_mei⟧ means "inscription" or "engraved words."

USAGE:
This is a very common question in Japanese self-introductions, job interviews, and school profiles. People typically choose a proverb, a famous quote, or a personal principle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {座右|ざゆう}の{銘|めい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to adopt as one's motto
- {座右|ざゆう}の{銘|めい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜です: my motto is...
- {座右|ざゆう}の{銘|めい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to ask someone's motto

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦モットー→モットー：29293_mottoo⟧: motto — loanword from English, more casual
- ⟦{信条|しんじょう}→信条：10451_shinjou⟧: creed, belief — broader, refers to a set of beliefs or principles
- ⟦{教訓|きょうくん}→教訓：12721_kyoukun⟧: lesson, moral — focuses on a lesson learned from experience
